doc: The cloud-producing ascent of a mid-latitude low (lon 20, lat 50, radius 0.2) for the ages of inputs.ages (0 a flat wave, 1 mature, 1 + 1e-9, 1.2, 1.45, then 2 and 3 beyond what build_flow draws): the head shifts from 0.8 east to 0.3 east + 0.5 poleward and stops moving at age 1; the envelope radius grows as 1 + 0.3 age; the dry slot 2 (age - 1) exp(-d2 / (0.45 r)^2) is subtracted for age > 1 only. Output row i is ages[i]. Float64 directions: float64 output, rtol 1e-9. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).
